description: This file implements the DynamoDBGatewayListProvider class, which is part of Orleans clustering using DynamoDB. It manages the lifecycle and retrieval of gateway addresses from DynamoDB, including initializing the DynamoDB table and fetching current gateways.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Provides an implementation of IGatewayListProvider that uses DynamoDB to store and retrieve gateway endpoint information.

methods.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies including loggers and options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB storage and creates the table if necessary with specified schema.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves current gateway URIs from DynamoDB based on cluster state.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property indicating the maximum staleness allowed for gateway list updates.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating whether the provider supports updates.
